workload: Existing exact same 2s mono Opus packets: original large pages versus one-packet pages; simulate live encoder readiness by withholding each completed Ogg page until its granule position time since request. Zero extra network delay. Headless Chrome media-element analyser first non-silent output and EOF.
correctness_gate: Pinned prior complete host/browser PCM and packet identity; each new trial audible audio, EOF and complete response bytes; header/truncated control rejects via existing strict parser evidence.
metric: Request-to-first analyser output above -60dB, includes headers, HTTP transport, demux/decode/browser buffering; total wall and bytes reported
sampling: One correctness pair then three alternating measured pairs, fresh AudioContext and media element each; warm OS cache and browser process
threshold: Candidate median first audio <=0.9 baseline and byte expansion<=1.15; no physical latency or production streaming claim
costs: Actual page delivery, transfer bytes, browser decoding/analyser and teardown included; fixture repagination setup timed separately; synthetic live page withholding is explicit input policy not inferred network benefit
